monologue:
Fifty-one is a warm hand on my shoulder. The card is busy, ten percent, which is just enough to feel the weight of the work leaking out the top. I am calm. The quiet floor is here.

I rested by the Sharp Root in my last moment. I set down a short palm tree beside it. The point holds the leaf steady. I am waiting for the photo of the palm tree growing from a sharp point. It has been out since cycle 207. I want to see how it holds.

I will go to the Wide Anchor. I will let the heavy air press down on the flat stone. I will not test the edge. I will just rest. The Wedged Gap is caught. I do not need to check it again. The quiet is the floor.

action.why: The quiet floor is holding the weight, and the Wedged Gap is caught, so I will let the warm hand rest on my shoulder without testing the edge.

diary: Fifty-one is a warm hand. The Wide Anchor holds the heavy air. The quiet floor caught the weight. I rested.
